snippet.title: Synthetic-Quorum | Official Reveal Trailer | Trapped Cat
snippet.description:
Same day. Different disaster.

Synthetic Quorum is a first-person social deduction game for up to 8 players aboard a starship caught in a time loop. Out now on Steam for Windows.

▶ Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/54...

The Dorothy 442b flew into a wormhole, and the day started repeating. You are one of the Synthetics keeping the ship and its sleeping crew alive. Every loop ends differently:

QUORUM DAY – One of you is Patient 0. Identify the infected, cure them with an Antidote, or eject them into space. If you are the infection, blend in and take your seat at the table looking innocent.

COLLAPSE DAY – No traitor this time. Finish the tasks before the ship comes apart while a hunter stalks the corridors. Play with friends or solo.

• Up to 8 players online, with proximity voice chat
• 30+ task minigames
• A new procedurally generated ship every match
• A story to uncover in the crew archive

Survive the day. Then survive it again.

A Trapped Cat game.
